FAQ

2026 5G Home WiFi Plan

  1. What is redONE‘s 2026 5G Home WiFi plan?
    The redONE 5G Home WiFi Plan provides high-speed 5G/4G data for a superfast internet experience at only RM78 for your first year.

  2. Who can sign up for this plan?
    The redONE 5G Home WiFi 88 Plan is available exclusively to Malaysians aged 18 and above.

  3. Can customers change plan when contracted?
    No. Plan changes are not allowed during the contract period.

  4. How do I subscribe to redONE 5G Home WiFi?
    You can subscribe to the redONE 5G Home WiFi plan through any redONE Partner or Retail Store.

  5. Can I make calls or send SMS with this plan?
    This plan does not support calls and SMS. The redONE 5G Home WiFi Plan is for data usage only.

  6. Can I use redONE Home WiFi outside Malaysia?
    No, the service only works within Malaysia.

  7. What if I want to cancel my plan?
    To cancel your redONE 5G Home WiFi 88 plan, visit us in-store. Please note that if you cancel your plan before your 24-month contract is up, you’ll need to pay: RM450.

  8. Is there any contract for the redONE 5G Home WiFi plan?
    redONE 5G Home WiFi 88 is 24 months contract.

  9. How many 5G home routers can I subscribe for with redONE 5G Home WiFi?
    Each customer is permitted to register for only ONE (1) home router, subject to an eligibility assessment. Any additional subscriptions will require an increased advance payment for each registration.

  10. How do I set up my 5G router to optimize 5G signal?
    Best placement of 5G router:
    1. Place your router in a central location close to a window where there is also a power source.
    2. Concrete walls, metal doors can reduce cellular signal from the tower. Placement in basements should be avoided.
    3. Signal strength: Once your device(s) is connected to the router, you can check the signal strength by checking the signal indicators on the Router or after logging into the 5G router web page on the connected device. If you do not have full network signal bars, try setting up the router in another location of your home.


    For better WiFi Connection:

    1. Minimize interference by trying to keep the following items no closer than 2~3 metres from your router: Cordless telephone base stations, microwaves, baby monitors, Bluetooth devices, wireless speaker systems.
    2. Avoid congestion since adding additional devices to your Wi-Fi network may reduce the speed for all devices on that network.
    3. Make sure you have a good Wi-Fi signal on your router.

  11. What devices can I connect to the router?
    You can connect any WiFi capable device in your home to the router such as laptops, phones, smart TVs, gaming consoles, and even smart home gadgets.

  12. Can I keep the router after my contract ends?
    Yes, once your contract ends, the router is yours to keep.

  13. What is the warranty period for the 5G router?
    The warranty period is 24 months from the date of purchase. Please keep your original receipt or proof of purchase for any warranty claims.

  14. My 5G home router is not working. How do I get it fixed?
    Please walk into any redONE Mobile Retail Store for a one-to-one replacement if your device is still within warranty period.
Terms & Conditions

2026 5G Home WiFi 88 Plan

General Terms

  1. The 5G Home WiFi 88 plan is available from 23 February 2026.
  2. This is a data-only SIM, which also supports hotspot sharing.
  3. The 5G Home WiFi 88 plan is available exclusively to new number registrations and Mobile Number Portability (MNP) port-in customers. Customers under Machine-to-Machine (M2M) usage or foreign nationals are not eligible.
  4. Customers may register under either a Master Account or a Supplementary Account.
  5. A registration fee and advance payment are required. If a higher credit limit is requested, a standard deposit will apply in accordance with prevailing procedures.
  6. The 5G Home WiFi 88 plan follows the device bundle line allocation rules applicable to all devices. Any additional lines beyond the allocated quota will require a higher advance payment.
  7. All stated prices exclude service tax, which will be charged in the customer’s monthly bill.
  8. The monthly access fee covers only the bundled high-speed data.
  9. The monthly commitment fee shall be RM78 for the first twelve (12) months, and RM88 from the thirteenth (13th) month onward.

  2. All prices stated exclude service tax, which will be charged in the customer’s monthly bill (excluding advance payments).
  3. Subscription to the Bundle is subject to a minimum twenty-four (24) month commitment period, effective from the activation date.
  4. Customers with outstanding balances or listed in the defaulters’ database are not eligible to subscribe.
  5. For the 5G Home service, the bundled high-speed data will be prorated according to the customer’s actual usage:

  6. Upon full utilization of the bundled data, Internet speed will be throttled to 64kbps. Customers may purchase a Data Top-Up to restore high-speed connectivity.
  7. An advance payment of RM200 is required for the 5G Home WiFi 88 plan. This amount will be credited back to the customer’s monthly bill at RM20 per month over a period of ten (10) months.
  8. redONE reserves the right to suspend or block the device in the event of non-payment of service fees, monthly charges, or any failure to comply with subscription obligations.

 

5G Service

  • The service works only within 5G coverage areas.
  • When outside 5G coverage, it will automatically switch to 4G.
  • The service may experience delays, interruptions, or issues due to third-party networks.
  • redONE Mobile is not responsible for any disruptions caused by the national 5G wholesale provider or other external factors.

 

Equipment and Warranty

  1. Availability of the Device is subject to stock availability during the registration.
  2. The image(s) shown on our website or promotional materials are for illustration purposes only and may not be an exact representation of the Device. We reserve the right to change the Device models with a device of comparable capability.
  3. The warranty period for the Device is throughout the Commitment Period.
  4. During the warranty period, if the Device is proven to be defective or your Device fault claim is proven to be due to manufacturer’s defect, we will replace the Device (1-to-1 exchange) without any additional cost imposed to you and subject to stock availability.
  5. We reserve the right to verify the Devices submitted for warranty replacement. If we find the Device to still be functional or have been tampered with in any way, we may impose a Device replacement fee equivalent to the price of a new Device.
  6. The Device warranty does not cover the following incidents:
    1. Damage, lost, stolen or defects to the Device caused by any act, omission, misuse, negligence, serial number removed or defaced;
    2. The Device’s network operator-lock function has been deactivated; or
    3. Other acts beyond our reasonable control.
  7. You may visit your nearest redONE Mobile Retail Stores if you have any issues with the Device.
